cohort: 115 newborns with gastroschisis treated at a single department in Romania between 1990 and 2012
finding: Low birth weight, sepsis, and the presence of compromised intestinal loops (complex gastroschisis) were found to significantly increase the risk of postoperative complications in newborns with gastroschisis.
mod_finding: Delivery was vaginal in 80.8% of the cases.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at diagnosis was 25 weeks for the 13 cases diagnosed antenatally.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was associated with increased risk of postoperative complications.
